title: Celestial Mother and Dragon
description: A woman with long dark hair and ornate purple robes sits in a cosmic scene, breastfeeding a baby wrapped in white cloth. A translucent blue dragon floats to her left while a large black bird with blue wings flies above her.
prompt: A serene woman with long dark hair wearing flowing purple robes and golden armbands sits in a cosmic night sky, breastfeeding her baby wrapped in white. A translucent glowing blue eastern dragon floats beside her, a large black bird with blue wings flies above, cherry blossoms drift through the air, a glowing lotus flower rests on the water below, surrounded by stars constellations and nebulae in a mystical ethereal atmosphere
